## Description

Ranks securities using a blend of valuation and momentum scores to balance cheapness with positive price trend.

## Where it may fit

Cross-sectional equity selection where combining distinct premia may reduce single-factor concentration.

## Vehicles

Long-only equity, long-short equity, multi-factor ETFs and quant funds.

## Required data

Point-in-time valuation ratios, total returns/momentum windows, sector classifications, liquidity and corporate actions.

## Caveats

Composite weights should be pre-specified or validated out of sample; value and momentum can both experience long periods of underperformance.
